exposure: absent or reversed end-diastolic flow in the umbilical artery (UA-AREDF) alone
absent or reversed end-diastolic flow in the umbilical artery and ductus venosus (UA+DV-AREDF)
abnormal Doppler with or without brain-sparing redistribution)
outcome: Time to reach full enteral feeds (FEF)
cohort: The study included 570 very-low-birthweight (VLBW) preterm infants born between 2010 and 2022.
finding: Antenatal Doppler abnormalities, especially UA+DV-AREDF, significantly increased rates of feeding intolerance, necrotizing enterocolitis, spontaneous intestinal perforation, and delayed the achievement of full enteral feeds in preterm infants.
